question: What is Diginex

beat.line: Diginex is building one platform for sustainability, data and compliance.
beat.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beat.action: Loose halftone sheets drift in and press together into one stack on a cream chip.
beat.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex is building one platform for sustainability, data and compliance.

sources: Diginex (DGNX) is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.
The company provides software and advisory solutions helping organisations collect, manage and report ESG, climate and supply-chain data.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: stacked paper sheets; a cream paper chip.
Opens cold on the ground colour; the first subject enters on the first frame.
Action: Loose halftone sheets drift in and press together into one stack on a cream chip.
Ends holding on the stacked sheets.
This composition is oversized: one subject fills most of the frame.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "ONE PLATFORM".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "ONE PLATFORM". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage. The scene opens on a flat, unbroken block-color paper ground of soft violet, photographed as a flat lay under soft room light. The camera is a Static Shot. On the first frame, a cream-colored matte paper chip slides in rapidly from the left with a slight overshoot before landing stably in the upper third of the frame; printed on this chip in an extra-bold black sans-serif font is the clean, legible text "ONE PLATFORM". Simultaneously, several black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of blank paper sheets, each featuring rough white torn-paper edges, drift in from various directions across the lower two-thirds of the frame. The sheets are oversized, filling most of the composition. These sheets move quickly, colliding and pressing together to form a neat, vertical stack centered on the violet ground. Each single layer of paper, including the halftone sheets and the headline chip, casts a small, soft shadow toward the bottom right, indicating a consistent light source from the upper left. The halftone sheets are entirely unmarked, with no lettering or symbols. The composition holds for the remaining duration, with the stacked sheets and the headline chip remaining perfectly stable and fixed in place.

overall_soundscape: A series of crisp, rhythmic paper-slap sounds occur as the sheets collide and stack. A singular, short adhesive tape-peeling sound coincides with the landing of the headline chip.
